skill.displayName: Midjourney Image Generator – Use Midjourney v7 to Create AI-Generated Images – API-powered
skill.summary: Midjourney image generator — create high-quality images using Midjourney v6.1, v7, or Niji 6

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Midjourney image generator skill.
- Generate high-quality images using Midjourney v6.1, v7, or Niji 6 models.
- Supports reference images, model selection, and aspect ratio customization.
- Requires a WeShop API key for authentication; checks the WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable before prompting the user.
- Includes secure API key handling guidelines—API key should only be used with openapi.weshop.ai endpoints.
